hook: ALMA sees no circumplanetary dust around the proposed protoplanets in the AB Aurigae disk.
summary: Deep, sharp ALMA images of the young star AB Aurigae found no point source at the disputed protoplanet AB Aur b or at other candidates, and the gas there flows smoothly with the surrounding disk. Any circumplanetary dust must be sparse, small, optically thick or lacking large grains. A non-detection cannot rule out planets, only dust of the kind ALMA can see at this wavelength.
title: Searching for Circumplanetary Dust in the Cavity of the AB Aurigae Disk with ALMA
